body: Esta aula treina **ouvir e anotar informações (IELTS Listening, TOEFL Listening)**.

blocks.body: **do away with** = eliminar algo que existe (regra, hábito, custo). Outros phrasal verbs: **get rid of**, **abolish**.

items.s: ___ and large, the proposal is solid. (By)
Should we do ___ with the long review? (away)
Were we ___ cut it, they would object. (to)
Hardly ___ I clicked when the page froze. (had)

blocks.title: Match the word to its meaning

items.ans: By and large the proposal is solid
items.pt: De modo geral, a proposta é sólida.

body: **By and large…** — De modo geral…
**Cut and paste.** — Recortar e colar.
**Back to the drawing board.** — Recomeçar o plano.
**Make the cut.** — Passar na seleção.
**Fall on deaf ears.** — Ser ignorado.
**Tick all the boxes.** — Cumprir todos os requisitos.
**Beat the clock.** — Vencer o relógio.
**Murphy’s law.** — Lei de Murphy.
**By and large, the proposal is solid.** — De modo geral, a proposta é sólida.
**Should we do away with the long literature review?** — Devemos eliminar a longa revisão de literatura?
**Were we to do that, the committee would object.** — Se fizéssemos isso, o comitê objetaria.

head: Phrasal verb

rows: Let’s do away with the old form. — Vamos eliminar o formulário antigo.

items.label: Pausas e ritmo
items.note: Faça pausas curtas entre grupos de sentido (thought groups) e mantenha o ritmo: sílabas fortes em intervalos regulares, fracas comprimidas.
words: In my view, | the plan | is sound.
Having reviewed the data, | we agreed.

blocks.task: Write an 8-line comic script about a grant application using by and large, do away with and an inversion.
blocks.model: Panel 1: By and large, the proposal is solid. Panel 2: Should we do away with the long review? Panel 3: Were we to cut it, the committee would object. Panel 4: Then let’s cut the footnotes. Panel 5: Hardly had I clicked submit when the page froze! Panel 6: Had you saved a draft, this wouldn’t matter.

body: Treine esta habilidade com o formato de tarefas curtas das provas (TOEFL/IELTS).
Leia o enunciado primeiro e procure as palavras-chave.
Use exemplos reais da vida dos alunos e peça frases próprias.
Corrija o erro mais frequente da aula em grupo, sem expor o aluno.
Retome o conteúdo na aula seguinte com um exercício curto.
